name: P.L.U.T.O. Rescue of Richmond County (Pet Lovers United Together as One)
aka: P.L.U.T.O. Rescue (Pet Lovers United Together as One)
notes:
All-volunteer 501(c)(3) no-kill on Staten Island. Uses the Merry Mutts Play & Stay facility (654A Sharrotts Rd, SI 10309) plus volunteer fosters. Dogs HW-tested; cats FIV/FeLV-tested; all vetted + altered + microchipped before adoption. Adoption donation: dog/puppy $180, purebred dog/puppy $280, cat/kitten $80 (incl. full vetting). App reviewed -> home visit -> paperwork at the visit. Mail: PO Box 140889, Staten Island 10314. Solid SI option beyond Louie's Legacy. No-kill 501(c)(3) since 2001. Cats + dogs (strays + owner surrender), full vetting. Runs a LOW-COST SPAY/NEUTER program + supports TNR for feral cats. Phone + email confirmed on own listings.
